aboutText: Alz Carpentry has been delivering expert carpentry and home extension services to Greensborough and Melbourne's north-east for many years. Led by Ali, our experienced team specialises in home extensions, house renovations, decks, pergolas, and timber restoration. We take pride in our exceptional attention to detail, clean workmanship, and reliable communication throughout every project. From initial design to final finishing touches, we ensure every element is flawless, transforming Greensborough homes with quality craftsmanship you can trust.
servicesText: From home extensions to timber restoration, Alz Carpentry delivers expert carpentry solutions for Greensborough and Melbourne's north-east homeowners. We specialise in transforming living spaces with quality craftsmanship, meticulous attention to detail, and reliable service. Whether it is a new extension, renovation, or outdoor deck, our team handles every project with care.
